spans.s: अण्णैयाचार्य author of लिङ्गनिर्णयभूषण, who was a Tamil Brāhmaṇa by caste. अत्(1) tech. term in Pāṇini's grammar for short अ, cf तपरस्तत्कालस्य
; (2) personal ending अ for इ ( इट् ) of the Ist pers. sing. Ātm. in the Potential, P
; (3) case- affix in the case of युष्मद् and अस्मद् for abl. sing. and pl.
,32: (4) tad-affix अत् (अ) prescribed after किम् in the sense of the loc. case before which किम् is changed to कु, क्व being the tad. formation; cf.
:(5) substitute अत्(शतृ) for लट् forming the present and future participles in the Parasmaipada. active voice cf. लटः शतृशानचौ.
